basic_info.description: Welcome to 151 Monterey Boulevard, a charming 4 bedroom, 2 bath view home ideally located near transportation and the shops and cafes of Glen Park Village. Blending classic details with modern updates, this inviting residence offers comfort, functionality, and style. The main level showcases a spacious living room with a beautiful period fireplace. Adjacent is the dining area and an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, ample cabinets and counter space, ideal for everyday living and hosting. Two generous bedrooms at the rear of the home enjoy unobstructed southern views. A full bath with skylight completes this level. The lower level offers two additional bedrooms, including one with direct access to the landscaped yard. A second full bath, convenient laundry area, and interior access to the one-car garage add to the home's thoughtful layout. The lovely backyard features a large patio for entertaining, a dedicated vegetable garden, a terraced lower garden area, and southern views. Set on a sizable lot, the home provides a seamless balance of indoor and outdoor living in a desirable neighborhood setting. With its flexible floor plan, modern updates, solar, and prime location near BART, Muni, freeways, parks, and schools, 151 Monterey is a special San Francisco home.
